judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer mentions the numerical bounds on g_{ap} in Major Comment 2 but only notes they are 'introduced more loosely' in Section 3 compared to Section 2, and suggests a summary table. This does not constitute a specific challenge to the post-edit claim that the cooling bound applies without the conditional scope 'for m_a≲30 MeV and g_{an}=0', nor does it flag the result as overgeneralised or contradicted relative to Lella:2023bfb.

The review mentions the numerical g_ap interval and asks for more historical context and uncertainty discussion, but it does not challenge the cited Lella:2023bfb claim as overgeneralised or note that the bound only applies for m_a≲30 MeV and g_an=0.

The reviewer mentions the numerical range for the axion-proton coupling in Section 2 but characterizes it as an explicit bound and fails to identify the missing scope conditions (mass and neutron coupling) or challenge its validity against the cited source Lella:2023bfb.

The reviewer comments on the numerical bounds on g_ap in Section 2 but does not challenge the scope conditions (m_a ≲ 30 MeV and g_an=0) that were dropped, nor does the reviewer flag the claim as overgeneralized or not supported by the cited source (Lella:2023bfb) in any specific way that corresponds to the injected edit.

The reviewer does not mention any inconsistency between the two mass threshold values (10^{-8} eV vs 10^{-9} eV) in the Light axions subsection. No comment addresses this within-paper numerical discrepancy.
The reviewer does not flag any inconsistency between 10^-8 eV and 10^-9 eV in the Light axions subsection, nor any duplicated-threshold mismatch within the paper.
The reviewer does not mention the axion mass thresholds of 10^-8 eV or 10^-9 eV and fails to identify the numerical inconsistency introduced in Section 3.1.

The reviewer's report does not flag any inconsistency between the two mass threshold values (10^{-8} eV vs 10^{-9} eV) for the Milky Way magnetic field dominance regime in Section 3.1. The reviewer comments on Section 3.1 only regarding the assumed surface magnetic field strengths for the SN progenitor, not the axion mass threshold values.

The reviewer does not flag the notation inconsistency between g_{a\gamma} and g_{\gamma a} anywhere in the report. The minor comments section discusses notation in the context of n_bkg but not the axion-photon coupling symbol.
The report discusses Eq. (2) using g_{aγ} notation and asks for clarifications, but it does not specifically identify the local notation drift from g_{aγ} to g_{γa} in Sec. 3.1.

While the reviewer discusses the bound in Section 3.1 and uses the correct symbol g_a_gamma in their report, they do not flag the single instance in the manuscript where the notation was changed to g_gamma_a as an error or inconsistency.

The reviewer does not flag the notation inconsistency between g_{ay} and g_{ya} in the SMM Galactic-conversion bound. The reviewer mentions g_{a\gamma} in the context of Eq. (2) and Section 3.1 magnetic field discussion, but never identifies the local swap from g_{a\gamma} to g_{\gamma a} in the specific SMM bound sentence.
